Shared atomic sorts, samplers, and operations for ReductionDsl

Trusted: definitions used by the statement. This file defines the sort signature atomicSig, coin-only uniform sampler tables (atomicBaseSamplers, atomicSamplers), and layered pure and cryptographic operation tables (atomicPureOps through atomicE2EOps) shared across PQXDH handshake, Double Ratchet and SPQR V1 session, multi-session composition, binary-harness adapter, and leaf-primitive reductions. See Computational/docs/TRUSTED_BASE.md.

Each sort in AtomicSort carries an explicit 32-byte block measure AtomicSort.blocks ℓ Pt: byte slices pbytes w and bytes w count ⌈len / w⌉ blocks, fixed words up to 256 bits and group points count 1 block, 512-bit words and serialized public/identity keys count 2 blocks, plaintexts count ℓ / 32 + 1 blocks, and composite party states (ghostSt, binSt) take the leaf-maximum block count matching Ty.Fits.

Multi-step Double Ratchet chain skips and SPQR symmetric-chain jumps are excluded from AtomicOps and expressed as bounded ReductionDsl loops over single-step operations (chainStep, spqrChainNextKey). Variable-length wire and state encoders clamp outputs to explicit bounds strictly above protocol-reachable sizes so OpsSizeHonest holds uniformly. The little-endian word helpers, five-part ML-KEM-768 split, and block-level HMAC/AES operations are adapted from earlier definitions by Charles Sutton.

def ghostStBlocksL79–87 ↗#

Leaf-maximum 32-byte block measure of a model party state GhostState Bytes.

def ghostStBlocks (g : GhostState Bytes) : ℕ := let pqBlk := (g.session.pqRatchetState.length + 31) / 32 let rcBlk := g.session.receiverChains.foldr (fun rc acc => max acc (rc.messageKeys.foldr (fun mk m => max m ((mk.seed.length + 31) / 32)) rc.messageKeys.length)) g.session.receiverChains.length let ceBlk := g.chainEpochs.foldr (fun e acc => max acc (bits e)) g.chainEpochs.length max 1 (max pqBlk (max rcBlk (max ceBlk (bits g.epoch))))

def binStBlocksL89–93 ↗#

Leaf-maximum 32-byte block measure of a binary party state BinState.

def binStBlocks (bs : BinState) : ℕ := let bBlk := (bs.bytes.length + 31) / 32 let chBlk := bs.epochs.chains.foldr (fun p acc => max acc (bits p.2)) bs.epochs.chains.length max 1 (max bBlk (max chBlk (bits bs.epochs.epoch)))

def AtomicSort.blocksL95–104 ↗#

Block measure of an AtomicSort value.

def AtomicSort.blocks (ℓ : ℕ) (Pt : Type) : (s : AtomicSort) → s.den ℓ Pt → ℕ | .pbytes w, x => (x.length + w - 1) / w | .bytes w, x => (x.length + w - 1) / w | .pu32, _ | .u8, _ | .u32, _ | .u64, _ | .bv128, _ | .bv256, _ | .pt, _ => 1 | .plain, _ => ℓ / 32 + 1 | .bv512, _ | .pk, _ | .idKey, _ => 2 | .fin _, k => max 1 (bits k.val) | .ghostSt, g => ghostStBlocks g | .binSt, bs => binStBlocks bs

def toLEBytesL218–219 ↗#

def toLEBytes (n : Nat) {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) : Bytes := List.ofFn fun j : Fin n => x.extractLsb' (8 * j.val) 8

def bytesToWordLEL221–222 ↗#

def e2eReadProstVarintL228–232 ↗#

-- Canonical `PreKeySignalMessage` (tag-3) and `SignalMessage` (tag-2) protobuf wire parsers. def e2eReadProstVarint : List (BitVec 8) → Option (ℕ × List (BitVec 8)) | [] => none | b :: rest => if b.toNat < 128 then some (b.toNat, rest) else (e2eReadProstVarint rest).map (fun (hi, rest') => (b.toNat - 128 + 128 * hi, rest'))

def e2eParseOptPreKeyIdL234–238 ↗#

def e2eParseOptPreKeyId : List (BitVec 8) → Option (Option UInt32 × List (BitVec 8)) | [] => some (none, []) | b :: rest => if b == 0x08#8 then (e2eReadProstVarint rest).map (fun (n, r) => (some (UInt32.ofNat n), r)) else some (none, b :: rest)

def e2eParseUint32FieldL240–244 ↗#

def e2eParseUint32Field (keyByte : BitVec 8) : List (BitVec 8) → Option (UInt32 × List (BitVec 8)) | k :: rest => if k == keyByte then (e2eReadProstVarint rest).map (fun (n, r) => (UInt32.ofNat n, r)) else none | [] => none

def e2eParseDjbKeyFieldL246–250 ↗#

def e2eParseDjbKeyField (keyByte : BitVec 8) : List (BitVec 8) → Option (List (BitVec 8) × List (BitVec 8)) | k :: 0x21#8 :: 0x05#8 :: rest => if k == keyByte && decide (32 ≤ rest.length) then some (rest.take 32, rest.drop 32) else none | _ => none

def e2eParseInnerMsgFieldL252–256 ↗#

def e2eParseInnerMsgField : List (BitVec 8) → Option (List (BitVec 8) × List (BitVec 8)) | 0x22#8 :: rest => (e2eReadProstVarint rest).bind (fun (len, afterLen) => if decide (len ≤ afterLen.length) then some (afterLen.take len, afterLen.drop len) else none) | _ => none

def e2eParseKyberCtFieldL258–261 ↗#

def e2eParseKyberCtField : List (BitVec 8) → Option (List (BitVec 8)) | 0x42#8 :: 0xa1#8 :: 0x0c#8 :: 0x08#8 :: rest => if decide (1568 ≤ rest.length) then some (rest.take 1568) else none | _ => none

def e2eDecodePreKeyRawL263–282 ↗#

def e2eDecodePreKeyRaw : Bytes → Option PreKeyMessageFields | t :: v :: proto => if t == wirePrekey && v == versionByte currentVersion then (e2eParseOptPreKeyId proto).bind fun (opkId?, after1) => (e2eParseDjbKeyField 0x12#8 after1).bind fun (bkBytes, after2) => (e2eParseDjbKeyField 0x1a#8 after2).bind fun (idBytes, after3) => (e2eParseInnerMsgField after3).bind fun (inner, after4) => (e2eParseUint32Field 0x28#8 after4).bind fun (regId, after5) => (e2eParseUint32Field 0x30#8 after5).bind fun (spkId, after6) => (e2eParseUint32Field 0x38#8 after6).bind fun (pqspkId, after7) => (e2eParseKyberCtField after7).bind fun kemCtBytes => if hbk : bkBytes.length = 32 then if hid : idBytes.length = 32 then if hct : kemCtBytes.length = 1568 then some { regId := regId.toBitVec, opkId := opkId?.map UInt32.toBitVec, spkId := spkId.toBitVec, kpkId := pqspkId.toBitVec, kyberCt := ⟨kemCtBytes, hct⟩, baseKey := ⟨bkBytes, hbk⟩, idPub := ⟨idBytes, hid⟩, inner := inner } else none else none else none else none | _ => none

def e2eDecodePreKeyMsgL284–287 ↗#

def e2eDecodePreKeyMsg (c : Bytes) : Option PreKeyMessageFields := match e2eDecodePreKeyRaw c with | some m => if c == wirePrekey :: m.bytes then some m else none | none => none

def e2eHdrOfPreKeyMsgL289–291 ↗#

def e2eHdrOfPreKeyMsg (m : PreKeyMessageFields) : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr := { ikAPk := vecU8 m.idPub, ekAPk := vecU8 m.baseKey, spkId := u32 m.spkId, opkId? := m.opkId.map u32, pqspkId := u32 m.kpkId, kemCt := vecU8 m.kyberCt }

def e2eExpectedPreKeyMsgL293–298 ↗#

def e2eExpectedPreKeyMsg (regIdA : BitVec 32) (hdr : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr) (inner : Bytes) : PreKeyMessageFields := { regId := regIdA, opkId := hdr.opkId?.map (fun id => BitVec.ofNat 32 id.toNat), spkId := BitVec.ofNat 32 hdr.spkId.toNat, kpkId := BitVec.ofNat 32 hdr.pqspkId.toNat, kyberCt := u8Vec 1568 hdr.kemCt, baseKey := u8Vec 32 hdr.ekAPk, idPub := u8Vec 32 hdr.ikAPk, inner := inner }

def e2eWireInnerBytesL300–306 ↗#
